scenarios.criterion: An order's frontmatter MUST accept an optional slice block (of, spec, digest, manifest, covers); an order with no slice block MUST validate exactly as it did before the field existed.
scenarios.name: An order with no slice block validates exactly as before
given: An intake order with no slice block in its frontmatter
when: The order is checked
then: The order validates exactly as it did before the slice field existed

scenarios.criterion: An order's frontmatter MUST accept an optional slice block (of, spec, digest, manifest, covers); an order with no slice block MUST validate exactly as it did before the field existed.
scenarios.name: An order's optional slice block is accepted when present
given: An intake order whose frontmatter declares a slice block with of, spec, digest, manifest, and covers
when: The order is checked
then: The slice block is parsed and accepted rather than rejected as an unknown field

scenarios.criterion: A spec criterion with observableVia api or ui MUST have one level to cover, and both MUST give it two (api and ui); AC1:ui covers only that level, a bare AC2 covers every level AC2 has.
scenarios.name: A bare covers entry covers every level its criterion has
given: A spec criterion observable via both api and ui
A slice's covers list names that criterion with no level suffix
when: The order is checked
then: The slice is treated as covering both the api level and the ui level of that criterion

scenarios.criterion: A spec criterion with observableVia api or ui MUST have one level to cover, and both MUST give it two (api and ui); AC1:ui covers only that level, a bare AC2 covers every level AC2 has.
scenarios.name: A level-suffixed covers entry covers only that level
given: A spec criterion observable via both api and ui
A slice's covers list names that criterion with the :ui suffix
when: The order is checked
then: The slice is treated as covering only the ui level, leaving the api level for another slice to cover

scenarios.criterion: Across every order sharing one slice.of, loom intake check MUST report a violation naming the criterion and level for an uncovered level, for a level two slices both cover (naming both orders), and for a covers entry naming a criterion or level the spec does not have.
scenarios.name: An uncovered criterion level is reported by name
given: Several orders sharing one slice.of
A criterion level that no slice's covers list names
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the uncovered criterion and level

scenarios.criterion: Across every order sharing one slice.of, loom intake check MUST report a violation naming the criterion and level for an uncovered level, for a level two slices both cover (naming both orders), and for a covers entry naming a criterion or level the spec does not have.
scenarios.name: A criterion level covered by two slices is reported with both orders named
given: Several orders sharing one slice.of
Two of those orders both list the same criterion level in their covers
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the doubly covered level and both orders that cover it

scenarios.criterion: Across every order sharing one slice.of, loom intake check MUST report a violation naming the criterion and level for an uncovered level, for a level two slices both cover (naming both orders), and for a covers entry naming a criterion or level the spec does not have.
scenarios.name: A covers entry naming an unknown criterion is reported
given: An order whose covers list names a criterion id the spec does not declare
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the unknown criterion and the spec that does not have it

scenarios.criterion: Across every order sharing one slice.of, loom intake check MUST report a violation naming the criterion and level for an uncovered level, for a level two slices both cover (naming both orders), and for a covers entry naming a criterion or level the spec does not have.
scenarios.name: A covers entry naming a level its criterion does not have is reported
given: An order whose covers list names a real criterion with a level suffix that criterion does not have
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the criterion and the level it does not have

scenarios.criterion: Slices of one spec MUST report a violation when their slice.digest values differ, when a digest does not match the SHA-256 of its manifest file, or when a manifest-listed file no longer matches its recorded hash, naming the file.
scenarios.name: Disagreeing slice digests are reported
given: Two orders sharing one slice.of
Those orders declare different slice.digest values
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the disagreement

scenarios.criterion: Slices of one spec MUST report a violation when their slice.digest values differ, when a digest does not match the SHA-256 of its manifest file, or when a manifest-listed file no longer matches its recorded hash, naming the file.
scenarios.name: A slice digest that does not match its manifest is reported
given: An order's slice.digest value
That value does not equal the sha256 of the manifest file it names
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the mismatch between the digest and the manifest

scenarios.criterion: Slices of one spec MUST report a violation when their slice.digest values differ, when a digest does not match the SHA-256 of its manifest file, or when a manifest-listed file no longer matches its recorded hash, naming the file.
scenarios.name: A manifest-listed file that no longer matches its recorded hash is named
given: A manifest listing a file and its recorded sha256 hash
That file's current contents no longer match the recorded hash
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the file that no longer matches its recorded hash

scenarios.criterion: Slices of one spec MUST report a violation for a depends-on cycle among them, naming every order in the cycle, and for a depends-on entry naming no order in the directory.
scenarios.name: A depends-on cycle among slices is reported naming every order in it
given: Several orders sharing one slice.of
Their depends-on entries form a cycle among each other
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming every order on the cycle

scenarios.criterion: Slices of one spec MUST report a violation for a depends-on cycle among them, naming every order in the cycle, and for a depends-on entry naming no order in the directory.
scenarios.name: A dangling depends-on entry is reported
given: An order whose depends-on list names an id no order in the directory has
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the missing order id

scenarios.criterion: A spec or manifest file that cannot be read MUST be a violation on the order naming it, and a path that leaves the project root MUST be a violation; an unverified split must never be reported valid.
scenarios.name: An unreadable spec or manifest file is reported against the order naming it
given: An order whose slice.spec or slice.manifest path cannot be read
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation against that order naming the file it could not read, and never reports the split as valid

scenarios.criterion: A spec or manifest file that cannot be read MUST be a violation on the order naming it, and a path that leaves the project root MUST be a violation; an unverified split must never be reported valid.
scenarios.name: A slice path that leaves the project root is rejected without being opened
given: An order whose slice.spec or slice.manifest path resolves outside the project root
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check reports a violation naming the escaping path
The file at that path is never read

scenarios.criterion: A passing split MUST print one line per spec with its slice and level counts, and the exit code contract MUST stay unchanged: 0 only when every order is valid.
scenarios.name: A passing slice split prints one summary line per spec
given: Every order sharing one slice.of together covers every criterion level with no violation
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check prints one line for that spec naming its slice count and level count
The check exits 0

scenarios.criterion: A passing split MUST print one line per spec with its slice and level counts, and the exit code contract MUST stay unchanged: 0 only when every order is valid.
scenarios.name: The existing exit-code contract is unchanged by the new check
given: A directory of orders where every order is valid on its own but the cross-order slice check finds a violation
when: loom intake check runs over the directory
then: The check exits non-zero, exactly as it already does for a single-file violation

scenarios.criterion: templates/claude-feature-team/intake/TEMPLATE.md and README.md MUST document the slice block, and the existing template vocabulary test MUST still pass.
scenarios.name: The intake template documents the slice block
given: The intake TEMPLATE.md and README.md files
when: A person reads the intake template documentation
then: They find the slice block's fields (of, spec, digest, manifest, covers) documented
The existing template vocabulary test still passes unmodified

scenarios.criterion: A fixture modeled on the reagent-map split MUST pass (AC1 and AC3 covered once at each level by different slices, AC14 covered bare by one slice), and each violation above MUST have a test built by breaking that fixture in one way, which fails when the check is removed.
scenarios.name: A realistic reagent-map-style slice split passes with no violations
given: A fixture modeled on the reagent-map split: two slices covering AC1 and AC3 once at each level, and AC14 covered bare by one slice
when: loom intake check runs over the fixture
then: The check reports no violations
The check prints the summary line for that spec

scenarios.criterion: Every new or changed function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths MUST change except this run's own delivery record under docs/features/intake-slice-check/.
scenarios.name: The delivered change stays inside its complexity, coverage, and scope bounds
given: The full set of files this feature changes
when: A complexity tool and a coverage tool are run over the diff
then: Every new or changed function measures below cyclomatic complexity 7
Every changed line is covered by a test that can fail
No file outside the order's declared scope.paths has changed
